en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said;
‘The continuation regarding the Fasting is that he makes his dinner as his pre-dawn meal’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ahmad ibn Muhammad from has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Connected fasting is when one takes his dinner during Suhur (breakfast in the morning before dawn) instead.’”
